name: Russia
summary: Transcontinental nation with vast boreal taiga and Arctic permafrost terrain. Undergoing twice-global-average warming rates with major permafrost thaw impacts and extensive natural gas extraction.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 2.40x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Siberian summer wildfire smoke periodically degrades Asian airsheds.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; high northern latitude warming accelerates permafrost subsidence.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Rapid subpolar warming rate of +0.52 °C per decade across Siberian and Arctic stations.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 5.1% share of global fossil emissions; 4th largest national emitter globally.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Heavy per capita fossil consumption due to cold climate space heating and energy-intensive extraction industries.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Hosts ~8,150,000 km² of boreal forest; represents one-fifth of all forested area on Earth.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Dominated almost entirely by massive Siberian hydroelectric complexes (17.8%); wind and solar remain minimal.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 8.8 people/km²; urban population fraction is 75.3%.
